sources.entry: Claude HUD by Jarrod Watts - A really stacked status line that exposes just about everything you might need - context usage, tools, agents, todos, etc. Highly configurable and actively maintained at the time of writing - code quality is strong.

summary.one_liner: Claude HUD is a Claude Code plugin that adds a configurable status line below the input showing context usage, rate limits, active tools, running agents, and todo progress.
use_cases: see how full the context window is while working
watch Claude subscriber rate limits and reset times
monitor running subagents and tool calls
track todo progress during a session
show git or jj branch and dirty state in the prompt area
estimate session or daily spend in the status line
notable: Two-line default layout with context bar and subscriber usage, plus optional tools, agents, and todos lines
Reads session data from stdin and the transcript; needs no separate window or tmux
Config in ~/.claude/plugins/claude-hud/config.json with a guided /claude-hud:configure flow
Optional external usage snapshot file and per-directory override via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
Labels available in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
caveats: Usage limits appear only for Claude subscriber logins, after the first response; API-key, Bedrock, and Vertex sessions hide them
Requires Claude Code v2.1.260 or later
Short refreshInterval values can cause errno 1 failures on Windows Git Bash
Optional --extra-cmd runs arbitrary shell commands and is disabled unless CLAUDE_HUD_ALLOW_EXTRA_CMD=1 is set
